facebook: Player of the match: Thabo Mokoena! 🦁 Thabo anchored our innings with a brilliant 112 off 118 balls, hitting 11 fours and 3 sixes, as the 1st XI beat Kensington Ridge CC by 34 runs in Round 4 of the Premier League at Old Lions Oval. Great support too from Sipho Ndlovu (47), Aiden Naidoo (31*) and Musa Khumalo, who took 4 for 38. Take a bow, Thabo, we're all very proud!

linkedin: Congratulations to Thabo Mokoena, player of the match for Old Lions 1st XI in Round 4 of the Premier League. Thabo scored 112 off 118 balls, including 11 fours and 3 sixes, to lead us to a 34-run win over Kensington Ridge CC at Old Lions Oval. It was a strong team performance, with contributions from Sipho Ndlovu, Aiden Naidoo and Musa Khumalo, and a great example of the commitment shown by everyone at our club. Thank you to our members and supporters who came down to back the team. #OldLions #OldLionsCricket
